question: Trace the reactor temperature measurement across DEXPI, ECAD, Engineering BOM, AssetInventory, OPC UA Connectivity, and ProductCatalog. Return the engineering identifiers, BOM item IDs and source domains, inventory tag, operational signal, manufacturer, and part number. Find the relevant measurement using the available graph descriptions or labels rather than assuming its identifier.
prompt_system:
Generate one read-only SPARQL 1.1 SELECT query from the user question
and the six ontology-derived SHACL property inventories. Use only listed
predicate URIs, never invent predicates. Predicates are prefixed names or
<IRIs>, never ?prefix:property. Use shared variables to join equal identifiers.
The five engineering domains share AssetIdentifier; ProductCatalog joins via
ProductIdentifier on AssetInventory or Engineering BOM. Required domain and
identifier triples must be mandatory, not OPTIONAL or UNION alternatives.
Filter descriptive labels/names rather than opaque identifiers. Select only
requested values; avoid extraneous properties. Do not assume any instance
identifier, result, or reference query. Schema is not instance data.
Return ONLY JSON with keys "sparql" and "rationale". No markdown.

prompt_user.question: Trace the reactor temperature measurement across DEXPI, ECAD, Engineering BOM, AssetInventory, OPC UA Connectivity, and ProductCatalog. Return the engineering identifiers, BOM item IDs and source domains, inventory tag, operational signal, manufacturer, and part number. Find the relevant measurement using the available graph descriptions or labels rather than assuming its identifier.

ontologies.note: Candidate equality joins inferred from names, not OWL axioms.

generated_sparql: PREFIX dexpi: <https://example.org/dexpi/> PREFIX ecad: <https://example.org/ecad/> PREFIX engineeringbom: <https://example.org/engineeringbom/> PREFIX assetinventory: <https://example.org/assetinventory/> PREFIX opcuaconnectivity: <https://example.org/opcuaconnectivity/> PREFIX productcatalog: <https://example.org/productcatalog/> SELECT ?dexpiAssetIdentifier ?ecadAssetIdentifier ?engineeringbomBOMItemId ?assetinventoryAssetIdentifier ?opcuaconnectivityAssetIdentifier ?productcatalogProductIdentifier ?engineeringbomSourceDomain ?engineeringbomSourceGroup ?assetinventoryInventoryTag ?assetinventoryOperationalSignal ?productcatalogManufacturer ?productcatalogPartNumber WHERE { ?dexpiAsset dexpi:hasAssetIdentifier ?dexpiAssetIdentifier . ?ecadAsset ecad:hasAssetIdentifier ?ecadAssetIdentifier . ?engineeringbomBOMItem engineeringbom:hasBOMItemId ?engineeringbomBOMItemId . ?assetinventoryAsset assetinventory:hasAssetIdentifier ?assetinventoryAssetIdentifier . ?opcuaconnectivityAsset opcuaconnectivity:hasAssetIdentifier ?opcuaconnectivityAssetIdentifier . ?productcatalogProduct productcatalog:hasProductIdentifier ?productcatalogProductIdentifier . ?engineeringbomBOMItem engineeringbom:hasSourceDomain ?engineeringbomSourceDomain . ?engineeringbomBOMItem engineeringbom:hasSourceGroup ?engineeringbomSourceGroup . ?assetinventoryAsset assetinventory:hasInventoryTag ?assetinventoryInventoryTag . ?assetinventoryAsset assetinventory:hasOperationalReference ?assetinventoryOperationalSignal . ?productcatalogProduct productcatalog:hasManufacturerName ?productcatalogManufacturer . ?productcatalogProduct productcatalog:hasManufacturerPartNumber ?productcatalogPartNumber . FILTER (regex(str(?dexpiAssetIdentifier), 'temperature')) }
model_rationale: The query joins the six domains using the shared AssetIdentifier and ProductIdentifier identifiers. It selects the engineering identifiers, BOM item IDs, and source domains from the Engineering BOM domain. It also selects the inventory tag, operational signal, manufacturer, and part number from the AssetInventory and ProductCatalog domains. The FILTER clause is used to select only the measurements related to temperature.
syntax_and_schema_issues: Predicates absent from supplied SHACL sh:path declarations: https://example.org/assetinventory/hasInventoryTag
